method: public long hardwoodRowReaderIndexed() throws IOException { long checksum = 0; try (HardwoodContext context = BenchContext.create(); ParquetFileReader reader = ParquetFileReader.openAll(inputFiles, context); RowReader rows = reader.buildRowReader().projection(ColumnProjection.columns(COLUMNS)).build()) { while (rows.hasNext()) { rows.next(); if (!rows.isNull(0)) checksum += rows.getLong(0); if (!rows.isNull(1)) checksum += Double.doubleToLongBits(rows.getDouble(1)); if (!rows.isNull(2)) checksum += Double.doubleToLongBits(rows.getDouble(2)); } } return checksum; }
